vulnerable_code:
class Exams::SubmissionsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_student!

  def show
    # Implicit primary key lookup without scoping to current_student
    @submission = ExamSubmission.find(params[:id])

    render json: {
      student_name: @submission.student.full_name,
      exam_id: @submission.exam_id,
      answers: @submission.answer_payload,
      instructor_feedback: @submission.private_feedback,
      score: @submission.final_score
    }
  end
end
diagnosis: The show action queries ExamSubmission solely by id without scoping to current_student. Any enrolled student can inspect other candidates' exam submissions, question answers, and confidential instructor feedback.

corrected_code:
class Exams::SubmissionsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_student!

  def show
    @submission = current_student.exam_submissions.find(params[:id])

    render json: {
      student_name: @submission.student.full_name,
      exam_id: @submission.exam_id,
      answers: @submission.answer_payload,
      instructor_feedback: @submission.private_feedback,
      score: @submission.final_score
    }
  end
end
